assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite atlas for Prochoro. Edit image 1 (the six insect bosses); image 2 is ONLY the hollow line-art style reference. Redraw the same six cute but angry insect study rivals in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, each fully separated by broad empty gutters and 15% empty margins inside its cell. Top row: bee holding pencil, rhinoceros beetle carrying books, firefly reading. Bottom row: mantis with ruler, round spider with notebook, dragonfly with stopwatch. Keep recognizable silhouettes, rounded friendly proportions, small grumpy eyebrows, readable simple details. CRITICAL: black strokes ONLY over genuine transparent alpha. Every enclosed body, face, eye surround, wing, book page, tool and accessory interior must be a transparent hole, NOT white paint or gray paint. No solid silhouette, no white fill, no grayscale shading, no glow, no shadow, no texture, no background, no grid lines, no label, no text. Crisp smooth black contours with uniform medium line weight. Reference 2's transparent interiors are essential. Whole canvas landscape 1536x1024; six isolated sprites centered in cells; nothing crosses a cell boundary.
